This course is also offered as a four-week intensive.

programs.name: Shinny: Older Adult
programs.description: Hockey Skills Adult are instructional programs geared towards skaters who are interested in learning basic hockey skills with a focus on puck handling, skating and game strategies.  Prerequisite: Successful completion of Learn to Skate - Beginner or able to skate one length of the ice surface. Mandatory Equipment: CSA approved hockey helmet with full face cage or full visor, a hockey stick, hockey skates, hockey gloves and a neck guard. Power Skating is a high-energy instructional conditioning program geared toward all type of skaters with a focus on speed, agility and coordination. Prerequisites: Able to execute cross-overs, backwards stop, one foot turn and backwards circle thrusts (skills from Learn to Skate 4). Mandatory Equipment: CSA approved hockey helmet and hockey or figure skates.
